All 927 mapped native bodies remain available by verified hash after cleanup. All 107 bodies without byte-identical package candidates were regenerated exactly from the verified locked OpenSSL archive. Production packaging is unchanged and licensing is uncleared.

jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 106 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core 0862dc01 passed 35 container and 29 local HTTPS checks, including active FFmpeg shutdown, video resume and metadata/user-data persistence after restart. Both official web and Qt 6 Desktop completed the original four-track FLAC album with automatic advancement, fifteen successful playback responses each and exactly one added play per track without a reset. Web active audio and Desktop audio EOF were observed. The retained backend kept its identity, grants, mounts, saved user data, playlists, studio favorites and original media hashes through explicit container recreation. Audio metadata now registers bounded missing artist names with persistent library identities. Current permitted credit sources govern visibility; inactive identities and favorites survive rescans. Twenty-two scoped membership comparisons, five artist details, four role lists and six mixed audio/album sort queries matched the preserved public Jellyfin 12 reference. Five empty-credit queries and sixteen preceding artist-list queries also matched; two uncounted orders remain qualified. Earlier eighteen numeric-order queries, nine tagged audio cases, twenty-nine personal-filter observations and forty-six partial user-data cases retain their preceding scopes in acceptance.md. Both official clients loaded Artists and Album artists and a generated artist's album page. Comparisons exclude album display names, plain-track Album fallback, parent DTO fields, artwork, genres and global unscoped defaults. Capitalized boolean query values remain a known reference difference. Album naming/creation, album-only artist registration, ambiguous names, wider collation, embedded images, broader tag formats, virtual-item edits, broader rating filters, complete recommendations/collections and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain incomplete. General Desktop video acceptance, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, audible quality, broader clients and scale remain unvalidated. Native final-position inconsistency remains unresolved; qualified negative-value and ended duplicate-stop differences are documented. See compatibility.md and jellyfin12-tagged-artists.md.
